item.title: Taming Incidental Polysemanticity in Toy Models: How Network Training Choices Affect Feature Entanglement
item.description: An exploratory study using sparse autoencoders to measure how L1 vs L2 regularization, initialization, and activation choices shape polysemanticity in overcomplete networks.
